Commentary.Commentary: So, it took exactly 3 overs for New Zealand today to clean South Africa up as Jeetan Patel bowled Morne Morkel out. 10 runs were scored in it which included two boundaries. Philander and Morkel made a 57-run stand to give their team a lead of 91 runs. Now, it will be the Kiwis to have a go with the bat. It'll be a difficult task to begin with, especially with the conditions being slightly overcast at the moment. So stay tuned as New Zealand's response will be coming up shortly...

OUT! Gone through the gate! Tossed up delivery around off which comes in with the angle. Morkel prods forward in defence but he cannot block it as the ball sneaks in between the bat and pad to rattle the timber. Jeetan Patel gets his man and SOUTH AFRICA HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR 359!
Short and wide outside off this time, Morkel cuts it straight towards the fielder at point.
Short delivery in the line of the stumps, Morkel uses his crease to defend it.
Morkel camps back and defends it off the back foot.
Coming in with the angle, Morkel tries to defend it but he gets beaten by the lack of spin and gets rapped high on his pads.
Down the leg side, Morkel clips it straight to the fielder at square leg.
Another short one but Morkel improvises really well. He guides this one through the vacant second slip region for a single to keep strike.
Short delivery, angled into the body this time. Morkel sways away from the line of the delivery to evade it.
Angling into the stumps, Morkel gets behind the line of the ball to defend it along the ground.
FOUR! Top shot! Full into the stumps this time, Morne stays in his crease and pushes it down the ground for a boundary through the mid on region.
Another probing length outside off, Morkel stays behind the line and tries to poke at it but is beaten by the away movement there.
Good length delivery angling into the stumps, Philander clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Neil Wagner will bowl from the other end.
A solid back foot defense from the left-hander sees the end of the first over of the day.

Great take by BJ Watling, but he's missed a stumping chance here! Oh, how close... Going down leg, Morkel misses his flick as Watling shuffles across to collect. He goes up in an appeal for a catch but doesn't realize that Morkel's back leg is out of the crease as he's doing so. Doesn't take the bails off and Morne Morkel survives.
Flat, short and around off, punched off the back foot to mid off.
Sliding in with the angle, raps Morne Morkel on the thigh pad. No appeal made as it was going down leg.
50-run stand between Philander and Morkel!
FOUR! Shot. Full on the stumps, Morkel stands tall and lofts it over mid on to send it across the rope for a one bounce boundary.

Huge lbw appeal first up from New Zealand! Jeetan Patel right on the money. Comes from around the wicket and slides it in with the angle, it raps Morkel on the thigh pad as he looks to play at it. Height the issue here.
The players are out in the middle. Vernon Philander and Morne Morkel will continue the proceedings with the bat for South Africa. Jeetan Patel will bowl the first over of the day for New Zealand.

Hello and a warm welcome to the coverage of Day 3 of the second Test match between New Zealand and South Africa. The visitors tail have helped them take a handy lead of 81 runs on this wicket which could be a vital one as the game progresses. The hosts will need to bounce back quickly if they don't want this game to slip out completely off their hands. A big day three awaits. Join us for the first session in a while.
.... DAY 3, SESSION 1 ....

With still one wicket to fall, the away side will want to take the lead closer to the 100-mark to put pressure on the Kiwis. On the other hand, the home side will want to start their batting as soon as possible. It should be an exciting day of cricket tomorrow. Do join us for it. Until then, cheers and goodbye!

The game has changed altogether after the first session of play where the hosts were dominant and managed to scalp four wickets but that was it for them. The visitors came back strong with the resistance shown by Temba Bavuma and Quinton de Kock, who put up a vital 160-run stand to get things back in their favour.

Once they departed, the hosts might have felt that they could run through the tail but Morkel and Philander had different plans altogether. They stitched an unbeaten partnership of 47 which has helped them take a lead of 81 runs. None of the NZ bowlers were that effective as they seemed tired after a tough day on the field.

South Africa have bagged another session under their belt. They scored 131 runs in 34 overs, for the loss of three wickets. Quinton de Kock and Temba Bavuma started the session really well but could not register the three digit marks under their names. They would be disappointed with that fact as they were fantastic throughout.
Pitched up on the stumps, Philander works it to mid-wicket. And as he does that, you can hear the umpire loudly say "Okay.. Time, boys!" So, that will be STUMPS ON DAY 2!
The batsman plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. One run added to the total.
Vernon Philander drives this full delivery towards mid off and takes a run.

EDGED BUT IT'S SHORT AGAIN! Wagner must be wondering why he's having bad luck with that. Short of a length and moving away outside off, Philander has a timid poke at it and gets a healthy edge which falls well short of Tim Southee at wide first slip as he dives low to try and take it.
Angling across the right-hander, it's left alone.
Full ball around off, driven to mid off for nothing.
Neil Wagner is back for the last over of the day.
Wrists this away on the leg side for an easy two. Got it in the gap nicely and hence was easily able to come back for the second.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Short ball into the body, Morkel pushes it to the covers.
Shuffles across to this one and works it to mid-wicket for one.
Back of a length around off, defended off the back foot.
Shorter ball around off, Philander looks to flat-bat it over the bowler's end but ends up mistiming it over mid on. Two runs are taken.
Length ball aiming the top of the stumps, it's kept out to end the over.
FOUR! Shortish on middle and leg, Morkel swivels a bit and pulls it down to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Coming in with the angle, it's worked to the mid-wicket region for a single.
Full around off, defended back down the track solidly.
Outside off on a good length, nice carry on that to Watling as Philander leaves it alone.
Length delivery in the off stump channel, arms are shouldered by Vernon Philander.
Comes from around the wicket and darts it a yorker on the stumps, Morkel digs it back out down the track.
FIVE WIDES! It's banged in short but it's too short, goes above the batsman and the keeper, all the way to the boundary line. Umpire signals wide so five runs in total for SA.
On the shorter side, on middle and off, Morkel with a solid back foot defense on the off side. Presented a nice straight bat to keep it out.
Shortish around off, Morne Morkel with an open face glides it to the gully fielder.
Back of a length, it's hit through the covers off the back foot. A double is taken.
The batsman has attempted to put bat on ball but fails.

The physio is having a look at Morne Morkel. He was hit hard on the front of his helmet. Some treatment given and the big man looks to be okay fortunately, which is always good to see. He has his helmet back on and looks ready to continue. Good sign.

NASTY! Absolutely nasty stuff from Tim Southee. Morkel is down on the ground as the Kiwi players surround him. Southee walks up to him to apologize. Banged in short on middle, Morkel goes for the pull but is hit right in front of the helmet. Climbed onto him too quickly and left him in no man's land.

Back of a length outside off, Philander punches it square of the wicket towards point where a dive saves a certain boundary. Little confusion between the batsmen again but no harm done. South Africa lead by 62 runs right now.
Outside off, shaping away. It's left alone.
FOUR! Fuller length delivery outside off, Philander drives it through the covers for a boundary.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Suddenly it's all happening now! Short on middle and off, Morkel top edges the pull shot over mid-wicket. Doesn't connect well so it falls well short of the fielder running in from the deep. There is a shy at the bowler's end as well which misses. Otherwise it would have been close for Morkel.
Short, sharp and accurate, on middle and leg, Morne gets out of the way at the last second.

That one just zipped off the deck. Venomous bounce for Southee as he bowls it just back of a length, climbs onto Philander quickly and goes off the shoulder of the bat. Wry smile on Vernon's face as he knows he'll be the one to bowl on it sooner rather than later.
Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot on the off side.
Moving and swerving about, outside off on a back of a length, arms are shouldered.
Full on off, driven back down towards mid on for no run.
Stays deep inside the crease to this length ball and defends.
In the corridor of uncertainty, Philander knows better than to fiddle with it.
Tim Southee is back into the attack.
Bouncer from de Grandhomme, it's not bothered with by the batsman.

FOUR! Top, top shot from Morne Morkel! Latched onto that one in a flash and pulled it away with absolute authority. Bang! He rocked back to the short ball and muscled it between mid on and mid-wicket to send it across the rope.
Full ball speared outside off, driven straight to mid off. Dot ball.
On the stumps, from over the wicket, it's pushed back to the bowler from within the crease.
Another one which is short and wide, Morkel flashes again but is beaten this time.

Pierces the gap well so it doesn't matter even if it was in the air. Short and wide outside off from around the wicket, Morkel flashes hard and gets it through the covers. The fielder chases it down as two runs are taken.
Works it away on the leg side for a single. Comfortably done.
Almost went through! Close. Slider on the stumps, skidding off the surface as Morkel goes back to defend. Came on a little too fast but he did well to bring his bat down to it.
Flat and short outside off, Morne Morkel goes back and plays it to point.
Similar ball, similar impact on the front pad. Same result. Always sliding down leg.
Shouts for a leg before but it's going down leg. Sliding in on leg, catches Morne on the front pad.
Full on the stumps, flicked to mid-wicket for one.
Colin with a length delivery slanting across the left-hander, it's left alone and that will be the end of the over.
On a length, Morkel shoulders his arms to it.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Outside off and it's left alone by the batsman.
Whoa! How did that miss? Big swing and a miss from Morne Morkel. It's on a length around off, coming back in as Morkel swings his bat at it. It goes underneath it and whizzes past the off pole.
Going down the leg side, Morkel looks to go after it but misses.
Colin de Grandhomme is back for a bowl.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
The batsman has driven that ball straight back.
Comes forward and nudges it on the on side.
Another one coming in on the stumps, worked to mid-wicket for nothing.
Full on the stumps, it's flicked to mid-wicket for a single.

Not out! Jeetan Patel starts off from around the wicket and bowls a slider on middle and leg, it's coming in with the angle as Morkel prods forward to defend. It raps him on the front pad and there are loud shouts for a leg before. The umpire says not out but the Kiwis opt to review. Replays show the ball to be clipping leg stump and hence, the decision will not be changed.
An lbw appeal against Morne Morkel is reviewed by New Zealand.
Jeetan Patel is brought back into the attack.
Fuller just around off, Vernon Philander brings down a solid, straight bat to end the over. Maiden from Southee.
A bit of away movement for Tim Southee. He serves it full and it's moving away outside off, Philander doesn't connect well as he ends up driving it towards mid off.
Fired in full and just around off, it's pushed back down to mid off. No run taken as it's straight to the fielder.
In the channel outside off, on an excellent length, tempting stuff but Philander refrains from indulging. Lets it be.
Wide outside off, left alone for the keeper to collect.
Fuller length ball outside off, Vernon with a solid front foot defense.
FOUR! Three boundaries in a row to end the over. Morne Morkel is on fire here! Cuts loose as he slashes it over backward point to send it across the rope. Lead is now of 48.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Morne Morkel. Short and wide outside off, Morkel stands tall and cuts it over point for another boundary.
FOUR! He's a decent enough no.11. And if he gets a half-volley, he's definitely going to belt it. Morne Morkel leans into the full delivery and drives it hard past the mid off fielder for a boundary.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Full ball on the stumps, Morne Morkel drives it towards the mid on fielder.
Wagner comes steaming in and spears it full outside off, Philander reaches out and gently pushes it through to deep cover for a single.
On the shorter side of things, outside off, Morkel steers it to deep point. Wants the run but is sent back by Philander. The southpaw is annoyed at that. South Africa lead by 35 runs.
Full ball outside off, Morne Morkel drives it back down to the man at mid on.
From around the wicket now, angles in a back of a length ball into the body, Morkel is hit around the rib cage as he looks to pull.
Hurls it across the left-hander, in the channel outside off, arms are shouldered to this one.
Back of a length on middle and leg, a fraction too straight as Morkel works it down on the leg side.
Short of a length delivery angling across, it's tapped away on the off side, towards point.
Full delivery outside off, Philander drives it straight to the fielder at mid off.
Good length delivery outside off, Philander cuts it towards the point region.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full delivery coming in on middle and leg, flicked behind square on the leg side for a single.
yorker fired on middle stump, kept out well by bringing his bat down in time.
Morne Morkel is the last man in.

OUT! Wagner strikes first ball on returning to the attack. The new ball does the trick without wasting much time. Length ball around off, Maharaj throws his bat at this. Gets a top edge which balloons towards extra cover. Kane Williamson is the man there and he settles himself underneath it to take a good catch.
Neil Wagner is into the attack now.
FOUR! Smoked! Short delivery and Vernon says thank you as he pulls it away powerfully over the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Angling in on middle and leg, Maharaj works it to the square leg region off the inner half of the bat.
Full delivery outside off, Maharaj gets it towards mid on off the inner half of the bat.
Back of a length delivery in the line of the stumps, Philander short arm jabs it towards the deep square leg fielder for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, left alone.
Length delivery angling into the stumps, Philander stays in his crease and pushes it towards the fielder at mid on.
And it will be Tim Southee who will have a go with it first.
The second new ball has been taken.
Dug in short this time, Maharaj sits down to evade it.
Full delivery in the line of the stumps, Philander pushes it down the ground for a single through mid off.
Another good length delivery outside off, left alone.
Good length delivery outside off, Philander shoulders his arms to it.
Full and wide outside off, Philander drives it but cannot beat the fielder at mid off.
Full delivery outside off, Philander blocks it away back to the bowler.
Second new ball will be due after this over.
Way wide outside off, Maharaj lets it go through to the keeper as it was too wide for him.
Angling into the pads, Philander clips it on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Good shot! Short delivery into the body, Philander rides the bounce and pulls it fiercely through the square leg region for a boundary.
Good length delivery just around off, Philander gets behind the line of the ball and pushes it towards the fielder at mid off.
Short delivery angling across from a length, the batsman shoulders his arms to it.
Keshav Maharaj will be the new man in for the visitors.
And with that wicket, drinks are on the field now.

OUT! Wagner gets his man! Short delivery into the body, Temba Bavuma takes on the short ball and goes for the pull. Finds himself top-edging it towards deep mid-wicket. Neesham runs in to take a fine catch. A beautiful and sensible innings from the Protea comes to an end. He too falls short of his hundred but played an innings of a lot of importance in the context of the game. New Zealand need a couple of more wickets to bowl SA out.
FOUR! Good shot! Short delivery into the body, Bavuma stands tall and pulls it through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Length delivery outside off, Bavuma rides the bounce and pushes it though covers. Two fielders give it a chase to stop the boundary. A run is saved in the process.
Short and way wide outside off, Bavuma hops and stretches to reach at it but fails to make contact there.
Bowls this one full outside off and Philander drives it for a single through covers.
Length delivery outside off, Philander pushes it to the fielder at covers.
Driven towards the mid on region.
Full and in the line of the stumps, Bavuma drives it down the ground to mid on. No runs taken.
Wide outside off this time, left alone.
Good length delivery angling into the body, Bavuma tries to clip it but he fails to make contact. The ball raps him on his thigh pads.
WIDE! Short and way down the leg side, Wagner slips in his followthrough. Bavuma is undisturbed as it was too high for him. The umpire signals it as a wide.
Good length delivery outside off, Bavuma guides it through the point region for a couple.
Back of a length delivery angling across, Bavuma shoulders his arms to it.
Full and wide outside off, Bavuma leans into the drive and plays it towards covers.
The ball is too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact.
Back of a length delivery in the line of the stumps, Philander stays deep in his crease and punches it off the back foot.
Way wide outside off, Philander shoulders his arms to it.
On a length outside off, Bavuma drives it through covers for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Bavuma pushes it back to the bowler.

Lucky! Does not carry! Full and wide outside off, Bavuma reaches out to it and goes for a drive. He gets an outside edge to it which falls short of the fielder at first slip. It hits Raval on his legs and ricochets towards the fine leg boundary. The batsmen manage to run a couple in the process.
Way wide outside off, Philander shoulders his arms to it.
Length delivery outside off, Philander drives it straight to the cover region.
Outside off, left alone.

Bowled in the line of the stumps, Philander shuffles way across and tries to clip it on the leg side but manages to find a leading edge towards covers. Luckily he did not miss or else it would have been plumb.
Again down the leg side, Bavuma clips it fine for a single.

Length delivery outside off, Bavuma shuffles way across and gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball then goes to the bowler who picks it up and throws it back to the batsman. Bavuma gives Wagner a stare who apologizes for his throw.
Neil Wagner is called back into the attack.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Philander thinks of defending it at first but takes his bat out just right in time to let the ball go through to the keeper.
The batsman has driven it through mid off.
Angled down the leg side, Philander clips it through mid-wicket. The batsmen run a couple.
Length delivery outside off, Philander gets to the pitch of the ball and pushes it towards the fielder at mid off.
Into the pads, Bavuma clips it off his hips for a single through square leg.
Angling in from a length outside off, Bavuma pushes it towards mid-wicket.
Down the leg side this time, the batsman clips it through to fine leg for a single.
A bit short into the body, Bavuma clips it towards the mid-wicket region.
Full in the line of the stumps, Bavuma pushes it down the ground and the fielder from mid on comes across to cut it off.
Angling in from a length around off, Bavuma shuffles and pushes it to mid on.
Back of a length delivery this time, pitched outside off. Bavuma opens the face of his bat and guides it past the diving gully fielder for a couple.
Good length delivery outside off, Temba Bavuma gets behind the line of the ball to defend it back to the bowler.
Around off, it's tapped away on the off side to end the over.
FOUR! Back of a length delivery angling into the body, Philander goes back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full delivery outside off, Philander stands his ground and drives it covers.
Fuller length delivery outside off, Bavuma leans into the shot and pushes it through the covers. A single is taken.
Going down the leg side, Bavuma goes after it but misses.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Bavuma stands tall and punches it to covers.
Just past the edge! Length delivery outside off, Philander hangs his bat in the air trying to defend it but the ball whizzes past the outside edge.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Bavuma punches it through the cover region for a single.
Again down the leg side, Philander works it square of the wicket for a single.
Angled into the pads, Bavuma clips it on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Lucky bloke! Back of a length delivery outside off, Bavuma stays in his crease and tries to defend it with an angled bat. The ball flies off the edge through the slip cordon for a boundary.
Another good length delivery outside off, Philander shoulders his arms to it.
On the pads, Philander clips it through the mid-wicket region for a couple.
Good length delivery outside off, left alone.
Angling into the pads, Philander flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Down the leg side, Philander clips it towards mid-wicket.
WIDE! Way wide outside off, Philander lets that go through. The umpire signals it as a wide.
Vernon Philander is the next batsman in.

OUT! A class act comes to an end! The bowling trick has done the trick! Neesham strikes in his very first over of the spell. Good length delivery angling away from outside off, Quinton shuffles across and tries to push at it. He nicks it this time and the ball goes through to the keeper. BJ Watling pounces on it and a brilliant fighting knock by Quinton de Kock comes to an end. He came in at a time when the South African side were struggling and he managed to bail his team out. A much needed wicket for the Kiwis.
Jimmy Neesham is back for a bowl.
Angling in from a length outside off, Bavuma stays in his crease and defends it.
Full and wide outside off, Quinton reaches to it and pushes it through to mid off and rushes for a quick single. They take on Williamson there and complete the single with ease.
Wide outside off this time, Quinton lets that go through to the keeper.
Good length delivery outside off, de Kock shuffles and pushes it towards the cover region.
Wide outside off, de Kock walks towards it and goes for the expansive drive but misses it completely.
FOUR! Good shot! Length delivery outside off, de Kock guides it through the third man region for a boundary. He is totally over the bowlers.
Tim Southee is back on to bowl.
FOUR! Risky shot! Tossed up outside off, Bavuma dances down to reach the pitch of the ball. He flicks it over the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Floated outside off, de Kock pushes it for a single through covers.
Short delivery outside off, de Kock gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
FOUR! Top shot! Tossed up outside off, width on offer and de Kock smells it very well as he cuts it past the point region for a boundary.
Tossed up in the line of the stumps, Quinton camps back and pushes it back to the bowler.
Good length delivery which nips in after pitching, Bavuma stands tall and pushes it to mid off.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Sprayed short into the hip line, Bavuma clips it towards square leg and thinks of going for a single.
Length delivery outside off, de Kock cuts it through the cover region for a single.
Full on the stumps, Quinton clips it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Full delivery angled outside off, de Kock reaches out to it and pushes it towards mid on.
Tossed up in the line of the stumps, Bavuma camps back and pushes it towards the fielder at mid on.
Spinning in from outside off, Bavuma gets in line of the ball to defend it.
Tossed up outside off, Bavuma prods forward in defence. The ball flies off the outside edge towards the fielder at point.
Full down the leg side, de Kock clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Tossed up outside off, de Kock dances down the track and pushes it towards the fielder at mid off.
Fired this one on the pads, Quinton stays in his crease to defend it.
This time it's a full ball, Quinton drives it through the mid off region for a single.
Length delivery outside off, de Kock stays in his crease to defend it.
Good length delivery angling across, de Kock goes fetching for it but misses it completely.
Full delivery outside off, de Kock drives this one straight to the fielder at mid off.

Just short this time! Another full delivery into the pads, de Kock clips it a bit uppsishly towards the fielder at short mid-wicket. Luckily the ball does not carry to him as it reaches to him on a bounce.
Full delivery angling into the stumps, Quinton stays in his crease and defends it towards mid on.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Spinning in from outside off, Bavuma gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
Quinton de Kock eases it down towards long on for a single
SIX! That just got better! Tossed up delivery outside off, de Kock gets to the pitch of the ball and slams it over the mid on region for a biggie.
FOUR! Top shot! Tossed up down the leg side, Quinton sits down and sweeps it through the square leg region for a boundary.
Full and outside off, Quinton dances down the track and blocks it away through covers for a couple.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Bavuma gets behind the line of the delivery to defend it.
Good length delivery which nips away after pitching, Bavuma tries to defend it in the line of the ball but gets beaten. He is lucky not to edge it.
Length delivery outside off, de Kock eases it down the ground for a quick single.
Length delivery outside off, de Kock pushes it towards the fielder at covers.
FOUR! Top shot! Short delivery outside off, Bavuma camps back and punches it through the cover region for a boundary. Good batting there.
Floated outside off, Bavuma plays a sweep towards the square leg fielder.
Bavuma gets behind the line of the delivery to defend it.
Short and wide outside off, de Kock cuts it through point for a single.
Tossed up in the line of the stumps, de Kock gets forward and defends it.
Floated outside off, Quinton gets an inside edge onto his pads.
The players are out in the middle. Quinton de Kock and Temba Bavuma will continue with the bat for South Africa. Jeetan Patel will start with the ball for New Zealand.
.... DAY 2, SESSION 3 ....

With the last session coming up, the hosts will want to pick up a wicket as quickly as possible to have a go at the tailenders. While the visitors will want the two set batsmen in the middle to continue and surpass the first innings score. Join us in a while for the final session of play.

An exciting session for South Africa where the duo of Temba Bavuma and Quinton de Kock have stitched in an unbeaten partnership of 124 runs. Both have managed to reach their respective fifties and have been dominating the South African bowling attack. The hosts have kept toiling with the ball but to no use as they hardly troubled the batsmen.
Full and curling away from outside off, Bavuma drives it straight to the man at covers. That will be TEA ON DAY 2!
Short and wide outside off, some width on offer and Quinton de Kock pounces on it in an instant. Punches it through to sweeper cover for one run.
Brings the wrists into play again, leans across and turns it to square leg.
Too straight and too full, on the pads as de Kock flicks it towards the mid-wicket fielder.
Fuller around off, de Kock defends it off the outer half to gully.
Attacking the stumps on a full length, de Kock walks across and defends it back towards mid on.
Fuller and angling in, Bavuma picks it off his pads and flicks it straight to the man at mid-wicket.
Full on off, blocked with a straight bat. Solid in his defense, is Temba Bavuma.
Well outside off, an easy leave for the batsman as he doesn't bother to offer a shot.
Temba Bavuma has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
This one is closer to the off pole, Temba pushes it back down in the direction of the bowler.
Full ball outside off, driven to covers. No run taken by the batsmen.
Short and wide outside off, Bavuma punches it through point for three good runs.

Almost dragged it on! The pressure from keeping the runs tight has forced an error from Temba Bavuma. Walks a long way across to this fuller ball, shoulders arms very late and gets an inside edge. It goes past a diving BJ Watling and away to the fence. That was a close one.
On off, blocked right underneath his nose.
Good length delivery outside off, arms are shouldered to let it through.
Full delivery aiming the base of off stump, Bavuma brings down the straight bat to0 keep it out.
Full and angling into the pads, wristed away to the square leg fielder.
Good over from Jimmy Neesham. He hurls it on a good length around off, defended off the back foot down the track.
Fifth dot in a row. This one is pitched right up there, pushed to short cover for nothing.
Similar ball, same shot, same result.
A back foot punch by Quinton de Kock as he hangs back to play it to covers.
On the shorter side of things, left alone for the keeper to collect.
Tight line from Jimmy Neesham, bangs it on a back of a length delivery and cramps Quinton de Kock for room, it's played back down the track off the back foot by the southpaw.
Outside off on a good length, arms are shouldered.
Full delivery attacking the stumps, it's driven to mid on.
That's the ideal line and length to bowl. Fuller length ball outside off, moving away ever so slightly, Bavuma reaches out to it to defend but is beaten past the outside edge.
Half-volley on middle and off, Bavuma with excellent balance blocks it out back down the track with the full face of the bat.
A fraction too wide outside off, Quinton de Kock reaches out to it and places it through to sweeper cover for a single.
Angles across a length ball outside off, Quinton reaches for it and mistimes the shot back down the track.
Full ball on off, driven to mid off. Dot ball to end the over.
Angling in on a full length, clipped through backward square leg to the man in the deep for an easy single.
FOUR! That's a cracking shot. Full and straight, right in the slot and de Kock hits it away with power. Hammers it back past mid on and picks up a boundary.
Outside off, played to covers for no run.
Fuller length ball outside off, de Kock drives it to the right of Jimmy Neesham who gets low in his followthrough and sticks his right hand out to stop it.
From around the wicket, it's pitched on a back of a length outside off, de Kock with a confident push in front of covers.
Jimmy Neesham comes back for a bowl.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. That'll be the end of the over.
Seaming away on a good length from outside off, easy leave for Temba.
Around off, bit ahead of a length, blocked out by leaning ahead a touch on the off side.
On a short of a length, outside off, it's played to point. Another dot ball. This is good work by New Zealand, it's necessary to cramp the runs and frustrate the batsmen as much as possible.
Stays right behind the line to this and deals with it comfortably.
Length delivery on off stump, Bavuma comes ahead and gets an inside edge onto his pads as he presents a straight bat in defense.
Drops it in front of the square leg region and jogs through to complete the single.
Shortish ball on the stumps, it's pulled through square leg for two more.
6th Test fifty for Temba Bavuma!

Fifty for Temba! Solid knock. Played the perfect foil for Quinton de Kock as this partnership is going along strongly. Punches this back of a length ball through the gap in the covers and comes back for two runs.
Angling in on the hips, nudged behind square on the leg side for a single.

Back of  a length outside off, de Kock cuts it towards gully where the fielder makes a good stop to his left. Latham the man there. This is what's needed, some athleticism in the field to spark life into your team.
Short ball to get things going for Wagner, Quinton de Kock squats extremely low and lets the ball go over him.
Switches the angle for the last ball of the over, arrows it fuller outside off, de Kock steps out and drives it through the cover region for a single.
Turns this fuller length delivery to mid-wicket and calls his partner through to complete the run quickly.
Shaping away on a good length outside off, left alone comfortably for the keeper to collect.
Too full again, probably looking for the reverse, Temba flicks it to mid-wicket. No run taken.
Full and attacking the stumps once more, no real movement for de Grandhomme, it's wristed down to mid on.
Starts off with a full delivery on middle, Bavuma walks a long way across and flicks it straight to the mid-wicket fielder.
Colin de Grandhomme is back into the attack.
Short and into the body, it's pulled away through square leg for one.
Fullish in length and bowled outside off, driven just wide of the deep mid off fielder for a brisk single.
Quinton de Kock drops this length delivery in front of covers and Bavuma takes off, is sent back and just in time too as this time there is a direct hit at his end.
Excellent ball. Angling back in on middle and leg, de Kock tries to play this across the line but misses and is hit high on the thigh pad.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Direct hit but he's well in. De Kock leans into the full ball and drives it to mid on. Sets off for the run but comes back just in time as there is a direct hit at his end.
100-run stand between Bavuma and de Kock!
Two more to Bavuma's name. He pulls it in the same area and comes back for the second easily.
Maintains excellent control as he puts this away. Rides the bounce well, Temba Bavuma, and pulls it along the ground through to deep square leg for a couple.
Full delivery coming in, gets right behind the line and wrists it in front of short mid-wicket.
Back of a length outside off, punched away in front of covers. Dot ball.
Marginally ahead of a length, just outside off, Temba with a gentle push back down the track.
Nicely done. Back of a length and Temba Bavuma is onto it quickly. Rises up and with the full face of the bat, punches it through the covers for a double.
Keeps it on the shorter side of the length, de Kock stays within his crease to defend it down onto the track.

An edge which hasn't carried! Wagner will feel hard done that hasn't carried, there was a healthy edge on that. Angling across, Bavuma has a tame poke at it and gets an edge which flies behind. It falls just short of the two diving slip fielders and goes through them. A run is taken.
Well bowled and well-judged. Neil Wagner hits the deck hard and bowls an accurate bouncer, Bavuma though picks up the length early and ducks.
Full delivery spared just outside off from Wagner, Bavuma takes a stride ahead and drives it elegantly straight to the cover fielder.
Back of a length delivery just outside off, Bavuma comes half-forward and meets it with a straight blade.
Fuller length delivery angling in on the pads, de Kock clips it to backward square leg for a single.
Bowls it slightly ahead of a length, outside off, Bavuma drives it to covers to end the over.
Bouncer from Southee, it's ducked and evaded.

FOUR! Pierces the gap perfectly. The extra protection is there but Temba Bavuma is exemplary in playing this shot. Angled in once again on the pads, it's flicked through the gap in the mid-wicket area for a boundary.
Speared in full on middle and leg, angling in, flicked straight to the mid-wicket fielder.
Drives it to the covers once again but gets it in the gap this time. A single is taken.
Fires a full delivery across the left-hander, it's driven to the covers for nothing.
On a good length and outside off, left alone for the keeper to collect.
Full ball angling across, it's driven to mid off for nothing.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
8th Test fifty for Quinton de Kock!

FOUR! Lovely shot. Full on the stumps, it's driven through mid on for a boundary. Fifty for Quinton de Kock! An excellent, attacking knock from the southpaw under pressure. Been superb till now and needs to carry on.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Length delivery around off, de Kock defends it off the front foot.

Drinks break! Runs coming fast for South Africa with Quinton de Kock leading the charge and approaching his fifty. 72 runs have come in the first hour of this session. Tricky second half awaits for NZ...
Full in the line of the stumps, Bavuma pushes this one towards the fielder at mid on.
Short and around off, Bavuma stands tall and punches it through covers for a couple.
FOUR! Too easy for Bavuma! Length delivery angling down the leg side, Bavuma just plucks it and plays it fine for a boundary.
Fuller delivery angling into the stumps, Bavuma clips it through to short mid-wicket.
Full into the pads, Bavuma shuffles across and defends it towards mid-wicket.
Short and wide outside off, de Kock cuts it past point for a single.
Another short one to follow for Bavuma, the batsman pushes it back to bowler.
Short into the body, Quinton clips it on the leg side and rushes for a quick single. His partner reacts well and they complete the run easily.
Good length delivery outside off, QdK pushes it towards point.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks in time to let that one go over him.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Again a loose delivery outside off, short and wide. De Kock slashes hard at it through the point region for a boundary.
SIX! Gone the distance! Short delivery into the body, de Kock confidently pulls it over the fine leg fielder for a maximum. That just needed loads of confidence to execute it and he did it well.
Full delivery angling into the stumps, Bavuma clips it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Down the leg side, Bavuma clips it through the square leg region for a couple.
Fuller delivery this time, Bavuma leans into the drive and plays it towards the fielder at mid on.
Way down the leg side, Bavuma again tries to clip it but is unable to make contact there.
Full into the pads, Bavuma clips it through the mid-wicket region for a couple.
Sprayed way down the leg side this time, Bavuma tries to clip it through but fails to make contact.
Dug in short this time, Quinton sways away from the line of the delivery to let it through to the keeper.
Short delivery into the body, Quinton ducks under it this time.
Back of a length delivery down the leg side, Quinton goes for a pull but fails to make contact this time. Wagner is lucky to get away with that ball.
Length delivery outside off, de Kock leans forward and punches it towards the mid off region.
Fuller delivery into the stumps, de Kock manages to block it away on the leg side.
FOUR! Good shot! Banged in short, angling into the body, Quinton de Kock pulls this one brutally through the backward square leg region for a boundary.
A bowling change for New Zealand as Neil Wagner is back on.
Way outside off this time, Bavuma goes way across and lets it through this time.
Down the leg side, de Kock clips it fine for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Bavuma punches it through covers for a triple.
Bavuma gets behind the line of the delivery and defends it.
Floated in the line of the stumps, Quinton moves away and pushes it through covers. A single is taken.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Good length delivery which angles in a bit after pitching, Bavuma tries to defend it but the ball flies off the outer half of the bat towards the cover region.
Length delivery outside off, Bavuma pushes this one towards covers.
Short delivery outside off, Quinton pulls this one through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Full outside off, de Kock drives it towards the cover region.
50-run stand between Bavuma and de Kock!
SIX! Another lovely shot to follow! Short delivery outside off, de Kock upper cuts it over the slip cordon for a biggie. His first six of the match.

FOUR! Width and punished! Short and wide outside off, you don't bowl these to the batsman of his caliber. Quinton stays in his crease and cuts it through the point region for a boundary. He will never miss out on those.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Floated outside off, Bavuma drives this one towards the fielder at covers.
Full into the leg side, de Kock clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Into the pads, de Kock clips it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Tossed up around off, de Kock comes down the track and pushes it towards the fielder at covers.
Floated in the line of the stumps, Quinton lunges forward to defend it.
Way down the leg side this time, Bavuma tries to clip it but fails to make any contact there.
Dug in short by the bowler, Bavuma sways away just in time.
Fuller delivery again around off, Bavuma gets behind the line of the delivery to defend it.
Fuller length delivery in the line of the stumps, Bavuma shuffles way across to cut the swing. He tries to push it on the leg side but manages to find a leading edge going towards the point fielder.
Good length delivery outside off, Bavuma goes for a pull but fails to make contact as the ball goes straight to the keeper.
Back of a length delivery to start with from Southee, seems like the plan for Bavuma. The batsman stands tall and defends it.
Tim Southee is brought back into the attack.
Sprayed down the leg side this time, de Kock fails to clip it and the ball goes on to hit his pads.
Quinton reaches the pitch of the ball and drives this one towards the fielder at covers.
Floated in the line of the stumps, de Kock prods forward in defence.
Short delivery outside off, Bavuma gets behind it and flicks it on the leg side. A single is taken.
Quinton shuffles and clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
FOUR! Top shot! Floated outside off, de Kock guides this one through the slip cordon for a boundary. That was a bit risky but he was always in control of it.
Good length delivery outside off, left alone.
FOUR! Top shot! Short and wide outside off, Bavuma cuts it just from shoulder height, over the point region for a boundary.

Shout for LBW! Bowled on the pads this time, Temba goes to clip it on the leg side but misses it completely as the ball goes onto hit the pads. The players appeal but the umpire stays put. It was surely going down leg.
On the pads, de Kock clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
FIVE WIDES! Dug in short, way short this time. Quinton ducks under it, even the keeper cannot gather it as the ball goes over him for a boundary. The umpire signals it as a wide for height.
Length delivery outside off, Bavuma pushes it towards the point region for a quick single.
Good length delivery outside off, Bavuma gets behind the line of the delivery to defend it.
Short delivery outside off, de Kock punches it through covers for a couple.
Quinton prods forward and defends it.
Full delivery this time, de Kock dances down the track and smashes it back to the bowler who sticks out his left leg to stop it.
FOUR! Improvisation! Floated around off, Quinton reaches the pitch of the ball and drives it through the point region for a boundary.
Down the leg side, Quinton clips it towards short square leg.
Tossed up outside off, Quinton covers his stumps and then shoulders his arms to it.
Length delivery outside off, Bavuma camps back and punches it towards the fielder at covers.
Short and wide outside off, Bavuma opens the face of the bat and guides it towards the fielder at point.
Down the leg side, Bavuma misses his clip as the ball runs down fine off his pads for two leg byes.
Angling into the stumps, de Kock shuffles a bit and clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Length delivery outside off, de Kock lets that go through to the keeper.
Good length delivery outside off, de Kock initially thinks of a flash on it but withdraws his bat at the last moment.
Full outside off this time, de Kock drives it wide of mid off for a single to keep strike.
Short and into the stumps, de Kock camps back and punches it towards the cover region.
Down the leg side this time, the batsman clips it through to short fine leg.
Floated up around off, Quinton dances down the track and blocks it away.
Tossed up in the line of the stumps, de Kock drives this one towards the fielder at mid off.
Floated in the line of the stumps, Bavuma shuffles across and clips it fine down the leg side for a single.
Jeetan Patel will continue from the other end.
Short delivery into the body, Bavuma fends it on the leg side and gets a single to keep strike.
Fuller length delivery this time around off, Bavuma drives it towards the fielder at covers.
Good length delivery outside off, Bavuma won't play for that line as he shoulders his arms to it.
Length delivery around off, Bavuma gets behind to defend it on the off side. He calls for a run but he is sent back by his partner.
Brave leave there! Good length delivery angling in, Bavuma covers his stumps and lets the ball through to the keeper.
Length delivery way outside off to start with, Bavuma stays undisturbed at his crease.

The players are out in the middle for the second session of play. Quinton de Kock and Temba Bavuma will continue with the bat for South Africa. Jimmy Neesham will start with the ball for New Zealand. He has two slips and a gully placed...
.... DAY 2, SESSION 2 ....

Credit to Williamson's captaincy who stuck with his three front line pacers and all of them responded really well. It would be an interesting second session where the visitors will need to spend some time in the middle to get back in the game. Join us in a while for the post-lunch session.

Duminy came in to join Amla in the middle but they could not make the partnership last as they both fell cheaply in a similar fashion. Skipper Faf du Plessis showed some resistance but could not last long as he went fetching for a loose delivery outside off. With the top order and middle order back in the pavilion, it would need something special from Bavuma and de Kock to reach a respectable score.

A dominating session of cricket from the hosts where they managed to pick up wickets at regular intervals. South Africa will be disappointed as they scored only 80 runs in the 26 overs with the loss of four wickets. The Kiwi pacers started off the day with a bang where Southee sent back the nightwatchman back to the hut in his very first over.

ALMOST! Jeetan Patel could have had a wicket on the final delivery before the break. Would have spelled disaster for South Africa had he did. Flat, shorter and coming in on the stumps, Quinton de Kock backs away a bit, looks to cut but gets a bottom edge which falls on the track and the bounces high ahead. Action-packed session comes to an end as that's LUNCH ON DAY 2!
Sliding in with the arm, de Kock wrists it towards the mid-wicket region but won't get any run for it. Was too close to the fielder there.
Comes down the track to this and blocks it out safely.
Floats it up around the off stump, it's blocked solidly off the front foot. Gave it some good flight and invited the southpaw ahead to play.
Coming in with the angle on middle and off, de Kock gets behind the line to defend.
Flat and short outside off, from around the wicket, Quinton de Kock goes back and cuts it through point for a couple.
Jeetan Patel to bowl the last over before lunch. Can he get a wicket here?
FOUR! Top edge and it's gone over the keeper's head. Oh... Talk about streaky runs coming your way. Bavuma gets a top edge on his pull shot and it goes over Watling's head to the boundary.
The ball is too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact.
From around the wicket, Wagner changes the angle as he angles it in on off, Temba with a solid defensive shot to keep it out.
Some chin music for the batsman, Wagner bangs in a short one. Bavuma doesn't have to do much as he gets out of the way.
Well outside off, it's left alone by Temba Bavuma.
FOUR Shot. Back of a length delivery outside off, Bavuma off his back foot offers a solid punch through the covers for a boundary.
Full and going down leg, Quinton de Kock with an attempted flick shot which misses.
Good length delivery angling in from around off, Quinton de Kock walks across and meets it with a straight bat.

Play and a miss! Quinton de Kock almost edges one behind. "Oooohhss" and "Aaaahhhss" from the slip cordon. And understandably so, that was close. Length ball outisde off, de Kock flashes his bat at it but just misses.
Quinton de Kock is the next man in.

OUT! THAT'S A HUGE WICKET! Big, big wicket. Colin de Grandhomme has put New Zealand's nose right in front with that. South Africa are in the deep end here. Full and swinging just in outside off, Faf du Plessis reaches out to it for some reason as he looks to smash it through the covers. Gets an inside edge which goes behind. Credit to BJ Watling here, he initially moves to his right and then dives low to his left and takes an excellent catch. Not an easy thing to do with the ball moving about so much. New Zealand celebrate but the umpire wants to check if the catch was clean. Replays show it was and the Protea skipper is out of here. The visitors still trail by 174 as they lose their 6th wicket.
Faf du Plessis has been caught behind. The umpires however want to make sure if BJ Watling took the catch cleanly or not. Over to the third umpire now...
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Length delivery aiming the top of off stump, Bavuma stays behind the line to defend.

Bavuma can take a lesson right there on how to pull. Faf hits this away with so much control. Places it in the gap through mid-wicket, a misfield out in the deep allows him to come back for the second.

IN THE AIR... BUT IT'S SAFE! Temba Bavuma in no control of that and almost got out. Lucky for him, Colin de Grandhomme lost his footing and slipped as he was tracking back to take it. Bavuma top edged the pull shot just over the mid-wicket fielder for a single.
Shortish in length, on the stumps, du Plessis pulls it aerially over mid-wicket but doesn't hit it with much power. It's in the gap and falls well short of the fielder in the deep. Single taken.
Flamboyant shot, a complete contrast to the one attempted on the previous delivery. Back of a length, he stands tall and punches it through covers to pick up three runs.
Oh! Action all around out there. Bavuma just went after it and it got the slip cordon excited. Short and outside off, Bavuma tried to smack it over gully but misses it completely.
Jimmy Neesham is also seen warming up. He will be eager to bowl a couple of overs before lunch. Will we see a new attack from both the ends?
Fired full and well outside off, at 139.2 kph, Temba Bavuma leaves it alone.
Once again, seeing it harmlessly move away outside off, Faf du Plessis chooses to leave it alone.
Faf opens the face of the bat to this one, slightly crouches and steers it in front of gully .
Outside off, it's cut away square on the off side for no run.
Jeetan Patel is warming up. Will he bowl the next over?
Just back of a length, it's outside the line of off stump as Faf du Plessis makes a good leave.
Quite a lot of movement in the air for de Grandhomme. Serves it on a length outside off, it moves in first, then moves away and after going past the batsman, swings back in again.
Full delivery but it's spilled down the leg side, du Plessis attempts to flick it fine but is unable to make any connection.
Back of a length around off, kept out off the back foot.
Good hand-eye coordination from Temba Bavuma. Is unfortunate that didn't go in the gap. Wagner once again attempts to curl it back in from around off, Temba drives it straight to the cover fielder.
Just a hint of inward movement for Wagner. He hurls it full and around off, gets it to come back in as Bavuma comes half-forward to drive it to mid off.
Lovely looking stroke. Bavuma gets big on the full delivery and just punches it through the covers for a couple of runs.
Shaping away from Temba Bavuma, outside off on a good length, it's left alone.
Back of a length delivery on middle and leg, Faf pulls it along the ground in front of square for a single.
Fuller in length once more and Bavuma defends it off the front foot. That'll be the end of the over.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Fuller length ball just outside the off stick, Bavuma leans ahead and pushes it back down to mid off.
A third slip is in place now for Temba Bavuma. So is a short cover.
Fullish in length, outside off, hit through the covers for three good runs. Nicely placed.
In the corridor of uncertainty, du Plessis is wary of the threat of flirting with it and exercises caution when leaving it alone.
Superb. Length delivery angling in on middle and off, starts shaping away after hitting the deck as du Plessis is squared up a bit. He stays back and blocks it out with a straight blade.

Almost draws the edge on that occasion. We nearly saw another dismissal on a loose delivery. It's served wide outside off, Bavuma plants his front foot across to drive and the ball whiskers past the outside edge.

There are few things in the world better than this sight. A great seam position on the red cherry, bathed in sunshine and in that off stump channel. Temba Bavuma can only marvel at it as he lets it be.
Short of a length on the body, the height isn't much on this as Faf pulls it along the ground through to deep backward square leg for a single.
Once more it's bowled outside off, Faf is absolutely sure as he leaves it alone.
On a back of a length, moving away outside off, it's left alone.
Sharp delivery from Neil Wagner. Bouncer on middle and leg, rising quickly as Faf goes for the big pull. Does not get on top of it properly as the ball goes over him.
Similar ball, same result and that brings an end to a successful over from Colin de Grandhomme.
In the channel outside off, left alone by Bavuma.
Temba Bavuma is the next man in.

OUT! HE'S GONE! New Zealand right on top here and they're on a roll. Similar to JP Duminy's dismissal, Hashim Amla departs playing a poor shot. Full and angling in on the pads, he flicks it uppishly but gets the placement all wrong. Chips it towards Henry Nicholls at short mid-wicket, who initially fumbles but then catches it on the second attempt as he falls down. The Kiwis are ecstatic as half the Protea side is back in the pavilion. Big, big wicket this. Colin de Grandhomme strikes instantly on his return to the attack.
Third leave in a row for Hashim Amla. Lets this length ball outside off go.
Good line, keeps it in that off stump channel, Amla makes another leave.
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, Hashim Amla shoulders his arms to it.
Colin de Grandhomme is back into the attack.

SIX! The ploy to take him out with the short ball almost worked. Faf du Plessis was not in control of that shot and is lucky it soared away over the fence. Short and around off, Faf top edges his pull shot over backward square leg. Manages to clear the man out in the deep and gets a biggie to his name.
Faf du Plessis stands firm and punches this back of a length ball with an open face to point.
Good length delivery angling across, Faf du Plessis covers the line of the off stump nicely and raises his bat skywards to let it through.
Moving away again, on a bit of a shorter length, du Plessis hangs back and punches it in front of point.
Slanting away from the batsman, on a length outside off, it's not bothered with by the batsman.

FOUR! He drives and drives beautifully. Width on offer, overpitched.. It's perfect for Faf du Plessis to go after it. He leans into this full delivery and creams it through the big gap in the covers for a boundary.
Amla gets his initial shuffle right, Southee bowls this one a bit short into the body, Amlagets behind the line of the delivery to defend it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
On the leg side, Amla clips it towards mid-wicket.
Amla shuffles way across, Southee sees the movement and bowls this one full into the stumps. Amla still manages to block it away towards point.
Scrambled seam this time. Bowled on the pads from a length, du Plessis clips it through the square leg region for a single.
Fuller this time outside off, the ball angles in at the start and nips away after pitching. Faf covers his stumps and lets the ball through to the keeper.
Good length delivery which nips away after pitching. Faf stays in his crease and watches the ball go through to the keeper.
Maiden over for Neil Wagner. Ends it with a sharp bumper which is ducked under by Hashim Amla.
Length delivery on middle and off, it's blocked out from within the crease.
Rock solid in defense as Hashim Amla pushes this one out. Walks across half a step and blocks it on the leg side.
Wagner brings out the short one and pounds the deck hard, Amla is watchful as he ducks quickly to let it sail over his head.
Full and swinging in, attacking the stumps right away, Hashim Amla goes deep inside his crease, positions himself behind the line and turns it to square leg.
Good length delivery hurled across, Hashim Amla prods forward and meets it with the full face of the bat.

Time for Drinks! A good cricketing contest here at the Reserve so far. Delicately poised at the moment, we're witnessing a good battle between bat and ball between two very good teams. The sun is shining brightly, the crowd is enjoying itself and we're in for another sweet hour of play.
Hurls it quite wide again, du Plessis covers the line well and watches as the ball goes past him to the keeper.
Well outside off, no chance Faf is going to play at that.
Similar line, keeps it tight but bowls it a bit fuller around off, it's hit down the ground by Faf for nothing.
Good tight line from Tim Southee. Bowls it just back of a length, around off and cramps du Plessis for room. The Protea skipper however manages to punch it off the back foot to covers.
Full and angling in on middle and leg, Faf leans ahead a touch and flicks it to mid-wicket.
Shortish and angling down leg, du Plessis looks to work it fine down the leg side but gets it off the hips it seems. Two leg byes are taken as the ball runs towards fine leg.
Length outside off, Amla lets it through to the keeper.
Outside off on a good length, Amla shoulders his arms to it.
FOUR! Beautiful! Full around off, Amla camps back a bit and transfers his weight forward to drive it elegantly straight down the ground for a boundary. There is no stopping that.
Angling across from a length, Amla covers his stumps and lets that one go through.
Bad line to follow, as he bowls this one way outside off. Amla shoulders his arms to it.
Angling into the pads, Amla gets this back to the bowler off the leading edge.
Full length delivery angling into the stumps, du Plessis manages to block it and the ball goes towards the square leg region off the inner half of the bat.
A good length delivery outside off, du Plessis lets that go through to the keeper.
Length delivery around off, the skipper pushes this one on the off side.
Full length delivery outside off, the ball started to nip away after pitching. Du Plessis first thought of playing at it but chose to leave it in the last moment.
Full into the pads, du Plessis drives it straight to the fielder at mid on.
Good length delivery curving away this time, Faf gets behind the ball and pushes it towards the fielder at mid off.
Down the leg side this time, Amla clips this one towards the fielder at square leg.
Outside off, Amla shoulders his arms to it.
Amla gets behind the line of the delivery to defend it.
Short delivery outside off, du Plessis pulls it over the mid-wicket region for a triple.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Faf punches that one towards the fielder at covers.

Skipper Faf du Plessis is the next batsman in for South Africa. He walks into the middle with his team in trouble and has to shoulder a lot of responsibility here with Hashim Amla. This will be a vital partnership for the Proteas.

OUT! Soft dismissal! Half volley into the pads, Duminy clips it straight to the fielder at mid-wicket. Nicholls the fielder there makes no mistake as he takes a regulation catch. Wagner will be relishing his luck on getting a wicket on such a delivery and Duminy will be disappointed to throw it away. South Africa have lost their fourth wicket there.
Curling away from a length outside off, Amla shoulders his arms to it.
Full outside off, Duminy drives it through covers for a single.
Angling across from a length, Duminy does well to let that go through to the keeper.
Full delivery angling into the stumps, Amla defends it off the inside half of the bat, through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Amla covers his stumps and lets it through.
Length delivery outside off, Amla guides it towards the fielder at gully.
Good length delivery into the pads, Amla shuffles and clips it through the square leg region for a single.
Another leave by Amla, wide outside off. Wagner needs to bowl on the stumps to make Amla play.
Length delivery angling across outside off, Amla watches it go through.
FOUR! Free gifts for Amla! Short and wide outside off, Amla stays in his crease and cuts it through the point region for a boundary.
Wide outside off this time, Amla pays no heed to it this time.
Good length delivery outside off, a bit of movement there for Wagner. Amla covers his stumps and lets it through to the keeper.
Neil Wagner is introduced into the attack.
Length delivery outside off, Duminy guides it through the gully region for a couple.
Another short ball into the body, Amla pulls this one towards the fielder at fine leg for a single.

FOUR! Short ball and put away! Dug in short into the body, Amla gets on top of the bounce and pulls it away through the backward square leg region for a boundary. Amla is looking really comfortable in the middle.
Back of a length delivery angling into the batsman, Hashim stays in his crease and blocks it back to the bowler.
Length delivery way outside off, Amla shoulders his arms to it.
Amla gets behind the line of the delivery to defend it.
FOUR! Good shot! Another loose delivery outside off, Duminy cuts it through the point region for a boundary. Costly over this time.
FOUR! Width and punished! Short and wide outside off, Duminy stays in his crease and slaps it through the cover region for a boundary. Easy pickings!
Leg bye! Down the leg side, the ball goes off Amla's pads. A leg bye is taken.
Another delivery outside off, Amla can leave those all day and night.
FOUR! Top shot! Full length delivery outside off, Amla relishes the length and drives it elegantly through the mid off region for his first boundary.
Another ball outside off, no movement there. Amla stays in his crease and lets it through to the keeper.
Good length delivery outside off, Duminy pushes the last ball of the over towards the fielder at covers.
Short delivery angling across, Duminy swats it from the bottom half towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Low full toss outside off, Duminy places it towards the fielder at point. He missed out on that loose one.
Wide outside off, the batsman is undisturbed by the line of the delivery. Seems like the movement is dying.
Short delivery angling across, Duminy guides it towards the fielder at gully.
Length delivery angling into the stumps, Amla clips it towards mid on for a quick single. Good running from the batsmen.
Another length ball outside off, left alone by Duminy.
Wide outside off, Duminy shoulders his arms to it.
Duminy gets behind the line of the delivery to defend it.

FOUR! So there comes the first boundary of the day! Easy stuff for Duminy! Full delivery in the line of the stumps, Duminy obliges by driving it down the ground through the mid off region for a boundary.
Good length delivery angling into the stumps, Duminy defends it towards mid-wicket.
Length delivery outside off, Duminy gets behind the line of the ball and pushes it towards mid off.
Good length delivery outside off, left alone by Amla.
Short delivery into the body, Amla stands tall to that one and defends it from his gloves. That might have hurt him a bit.
Down the leg side, Amla tries to clip it on the leg side but misses.
That nearly dragged on! Full delivery outside off, the ball nips in the air. Duminy gets an inside edge which just goes past the stumps towards fine leg for a single.
Some sawdust is being put on the landing area.
Good length delivery curving in to the batsman, Duminy stays in his crease to defend it.
Length delivery angling across, Duminy reads the line well, gets behind the ball and defends it well.
Fuller length delivery to end the over, Amla stays in his crease and blocks it away with ease. Two maidens in a row for Colin.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Amla shuffles a bit across and lets this one go through to the keeper.
Length delivery angling into the stumps, Amla gets behind the line of the delivery to defend it.
Another leave from Amla this time, he hardly plays any delivery outside off. And he rightly does not need to do so.
Good length delivery outside off, Amla shoulders his arms to it.
Another delivery curling away from a length outside off, left alone.
Length delivery outside off, Duminy goes for the drive but fails to make contact.
JP Duminy is the new batsman in.

OUT! Gone through the gate! Full inswinging delivery angling into the pads, Rabada moves a bit away and tries to clip it through. He fails to make contact and the ball hits the pads first, then goes onto hit the timber. The nightwatchman's short stay in the middle comes to an end. Southee gets the first wicket of the day and his initial plan of getting his man has worked this time around.
Beautiful line around off, the ball curls away a bit. Amla gets behind the line of the ball and guides it through point for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Amla shoulders his arms to let that through.
Way down the leg side, Amla fails to clip this one through.
Length delivery angling across, Rabada gets it through the mid-wicket region through the inner half of his bat for a single.
Tim Southee will bowl from the other end. Has three slips and a gully in place.

Shout for LBW! Good line this time by Colin. Angling in from a good length, Amla stays in his crease and tries to clip it on the leg side but misses. The ball raps him on the pads and the players appeal. The umpire stays put as it was too high.
So here comes the fourth leave in the row. Colin de Grandhomme is bowling on a line for which Amla will never play for.
A bit around off this time, Amla is confident about his stumps as he makes another brave leave.
Way outside off and curling away, Hashim Amla covers his stumps and shoulders his arms to it.
Length delivery outside off, left alone.
Good length delivery angling in the line of the stumps, Amla stays in his crease and defends it.

The players are out in the middle for the first session of the second day. Kagiso Rabada and Hashim Amla will continue with the bat for South Africa. Colin de Grandhomme starts with the ball for New Zealand. Here we go...

Hello and a warm welcome to the coverage of Day 2 of the second Test match between New Zealand and South Africa. A determined innings led by Henry Nicholls has helped the hosts reach a first innings score of 268 after struggling at 101/5. The two quick wickets which the home side scalped in the 7 overs they bowled, made the day even. South Africa, on the other hand, will want to stitch in a couple of decent partnerships to get back in the game. It should be an exciting day of cricket. Stay tuned as the first ball isn't far away.
.... DAY 2, SESSION 1 ....

The Proteas have lost both their openers and now have Hashim Amla along with Kagiso Rabada out there in the middle. With the new ball still quite new and the wicket offering a lot, day 2 is poised for some excellent cricketing action. The South African batsmen will have to really apply themselves and play with a lot of patience to stick around. Do join us tomorrow for another exciting day. Till then, cheers!

A brilliant, brilliant final half hour for New Zealand! After posting a total of 268 on the board, they came out to bowl and were on the money right from the off. Tim Southee got things underway as he dismissed Stephen Cook first and then, Colin de Grandhomme got rid of the in-form Dean Elgar. Both were caught behind by Jimmy Neesham at second slip. Southee almost dismissed the Nightwatchman Rabada in the last over of the day but just missed out on doing so.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Full toss on the stumps, Rabada just places his bat on it and guides it straight down the ground for a boundary. There was no stopping it. THAT'S STUMPS ON DAY 1.
Another delivery dug in short, Rabada ducks under it.
Short delivery into the body, Rabada sways away from the line of the ball.
FOUR! Good shot! Length delivery outside off, Rabada guides it through the point region for a boundary.
Good length delivery outside off, Rabada shoulders his arms to it.

FOUR BYES! That's gone through everything! Absolute ripper there by Southee! Angling in from a length, Rabada prods forward in defence but he fails to make contact. The ball sneaks in between his bat and pad. Luckily goes just past the leg stump and the keeper dives but cannot reach it. The ball races away towards the boundary.
Well, seems like we're going to have another over. Interesting...
Way outside off, Amla lets it through to the keeper.
Angling in from a length outside off, Amla stays in his crease and defends it.
Good length delivery outside off, left alone.
Hashim Amla walks into the middle next. Still 3 balls left for end of day's play. Are we in for some more drama?

OUT! Colin de Grandhomme gets his first! Length delivery angling into the stumps from just outside off, Elgar stretches forward to reach at it and ends up edging it towards the fielder at second slip. Neesham grabs another one as he crouches low to catch it. With both the openers back in the hut, the Kiwis will be delighted.
Good length delivery outside off, the batsman shoulders his arms to it.
Length delivery outside off, left alone.
Short delivery way outside off, Rabada stays undisturbed in the crease.
Angling across from a length outside off, left alone by Rabada.
Kagiso Rabada will be the new man in to bat. He's sent as the Nightwatchman to see out the remaining few overs left in the day.

OUT! Southee draws first blood! Length delivery curving away, Cook falls prey to the delivery as he goes fishing for it. The ball catches the outside edge and goes towards the fielder at second slip. Neesham stays put and takes an easy catch. The Kiwis are delighted as Cook walks back to the hut. Can they scalp another one before the end of first days play?
Full delivery outside off, Cook drives it straight to the fielder at covers. No runs there.
Good length delivery outside off which nips away after pitching. Cook shoulders his arms to it.
Short delivery into the body, Cook hops and defends in on the leg side. He played that really well.
Nipping back in after pitching around off, Elgar reads the length well and defends it.
Angling across from outside off, Elgar covers the stumps and lets the ball through.
Full in the line of the stumps, Elgar drives it straight towards the fielder at mid on.
Good length delivery which nips back in, Elgar adjusts himself and defends it towards mid-wicket.
Again down the leg side, Cook clips it fine for a single.
Sprayed down the leg side, Cook gets behind the line of the ball and pushes it towards the fielder at mid on.
Angling in from a length outside off, Elgar covers his stumps and lets it through to the keeper.
Good length delivery outside off, Elgar guides it through the point region for a couple.

Another length delivery, Elgar has his long stride forward to kill the movement again. This time manages to drive it towards the fielder at mid off. Seems like a very good tactic to counter the seam movement.
Length delivery outside off, Elgar cuts it towards the fielder the point.
Full just outside off, Elgar kills the movement and drives it down the ground through mid off for a couple.
FOUR! A bit lucky! Length delivery outside off, Elgar strides forward and opens the face of the bat. The ball flies off the outer half of the bat through the gully region for a boundary.
Length delivery down the leg side, the ball nips in back to the batsman. Elgar pushes it through mid on for a single.
Too wide outside off, Elgar shoulders his arms to it.
Back of a length delivery down the leg side, Elgar clips it towards mid-wicket.
Angling across from a length outside off, left alone.
Full into the stumps, Elgar drives it towards the fielder at mid on.
Good length delivery coming in from around off to start with, Elgar stands in his crease and defends it down on the ground.
Colin de Grandhomme will share the new ball with Tim Southee.

Perfect line and length from Tim Southee. Bowls it on a length in that off stump channel, enough away movement as it beats the outside edge of Stephen Cook's bat. Good delivery to end the over. Good start from Southee.
Gets it to go away from the batsman on a shorter length, well outside off, Cook covers the line and lets it be.
Full and swinging away on middle and off, Stephen Cook leans ahead a touch and plays it back down the track. The bat turned in his hands a bit as he played that.
Swerving away on a back of a length, around off, Cook opens the face of the bat and taps it to point.
A bit too straight as it's served on the pads, Cook hops across and tucks it through backward square leg for a couple of runs.
Excellent carry for Tim Southee, right from the word go. Hurls it on a back of  a length outside off, Stephen Cook shoulders his arms to it.
